# Independent SOURCE Review — Crystal Ball UX-026

**Branch:** `codex/alert-location-impact` · **Tip:** `c5879720c140bb883c39e66ec363c46838df6fff` · **Base:** `main` `7bbb43b35`
**Method:** Read/Grep/Glob only. No edits, no network, no test execution. Reviewed `claude-final.diff` (18 source/test files + docs), changed production source, surrounding callers, and the sidecar contract. Records were read, not assumed.

> Note on pinning: I cannot run `git` (no Bash), so I could not independently confirm working-tree `HEAD` equals the stated SHA. ## Findings

### MEDIUM — residual (fail-safe)
**1. Whole-batch NWS rejection on any single malformed item** — `src/services/nws-alerts.ts:186-189`
`normalizeNwsAlert` throwing for one bad item rejects the *entire* response, so one anomalous alert drops *all* alerts that cycle.
- Mitigating: the sidecar upstream query constrains `status=actual&message_type=alert,update&severity=…` (`src-tauri/sidecar/local-api-server.mjs:10848-10849`), and every caller fails safe — `refreshStormPosture` swallows and keeps prior posture (`storm-posture-state.ts:302-304`), the three data-loader sites fall back to offline cache / `stormContext` / non-critical catch (`data-loader.ts:622,3281,4373`), and `withOfflineCache` re-serves the last good snapshot (`offline-alert-cache.ts:186-211`).
- Residual: CAP makes `<expires>` optional; a genuine, valid alert lacking `expires` (or any out-of-enum field) suppresses the whole batch → the alert set goes *stale*, never *false-clear*. For a safety feed, per-item skip would be safer than all-or-nothing.
- **Non-blocking** — degrades to safe-stale; no false all-clear path.

### MEDIUM — completeness (fail-closed)
**2. Lifecycle gate requires `onset`, which CAP/NWS treat as optional** — `src/services/digest-alert-projection.ts:5833-5847`
`hasCurrentNwsLifecycle` requires `onset !== null && onset <= now`, yet the same change set explicitly treats onset as optional (`alert-normalizer.ts:127` `onset ?? sent`; `nws-alerts.ts:357-358` deletes empty onset). NWS alerts that omit `onset` therefore project as `impactStatus:'unknown'` even with valid geometry + fresh retrieval, so saved-place overlap silently under-reports for onset-less alerts.
- The fail-closed suite (`digest-alert-projection.test.mts:311-318`) mutates onset to a *future* value but never *removes* it, so onset-absent is untested.
- Fails to `unknown` (never a false negative/positive), so safety-honest.
- **Non-blocking** — recommend either falling back to `effective`/`sent` in the gate or documenting the intentional strictness.

### LOW — the two disclosed surviving mutants (verified redundant)
**3a. `42-expired-boundary-gate`** — `digest-alert-projection.ts:6145-6156` (`nextEvidenceBoundary`). The recheck-eligibility guard isn't distinguished by fixtures, but rendered status is independently gated by `hasCurrentNwsLifecycle` at projection time, so a mis-scheduled recheck cannot render a wrong status.
**3b. `43-timer-replacement`** — `panel-layout.ts` `armDigestRecheck` (~:1441). The in-helper `cancelDigestRecheck?.()` is redundant because every current caller (`reprojectDigest`, `requestDigest`) pre-cancels; the only exposure is a *future* caller invoking `armDigestRecheck` without cancelling first.
Both are honestly recorded as "no claim of test sensitivity" (`UX-026-FOURTH-MUTATION-PROOFS.md:888,907`). Neither is a current correctness/safety hole.

### INFO — positive, verified
- **Privacy/injection:** the model receives only opaque `A{n}` tokens + public facts; `resource`/`local-ids` withheld (`crystal-ball-chat.ts:5422-5424`); **saved places are never sent to the model** — projection is local (`digest-alert-projection.ts`); the parser accepts only `{alertTokens:[…]}` (strict key/length/uniqueness, `crystal-ball-chat.ts:5461-5486`) and narrative is derived from the alert's own sanitized title/body, so the model cannot inject rendered prose; `DigestOverlay` renders via `textContent` only (no `innerHTML` → no XSS); hydration strips a tampered `spatialScope` (`unified-alerts.ts:6533-6539`).
- **Geometry/DoS:** preflight + shared work budget degrade oversized/at-cap geometries to `unknown` instead of hanging (tested `:432,:451`); antimeridian-aware point-in-polygon; WeakMap parse cache.
- **Teardown/race:** `panel-layout.ts` `destroy()` cancels the scheduled digest, aborts the controller, bumps `digestGeneration`, unsubscribes alerts/places, removes visibility + `cb:show-digest` listeners, and destroys the overlay; `DigestOverlay.destroy()` removes its own listeners + DOM; the generation counter invalidates late async completions; FAA panel `loadGeneration` guards stale overwrites and is bumped on destroy.
- **Signature-change safety:** the changed `generateDigest` (`crystal-ball-chat.ts:621`, now `Promise<DigestStoryCard[]>`) has exactly one consumer (`panel-layout.ts:1532`, updated); `NotificationDigestPanel` imports the *unrelated* `notification-digest.generateDigest` (`NotificationDigestPanel.ts:19`). The `LiveAlertInput` union tightening is satisfied by the sole runtime caller's `as unknown as` cast (`storm-posture-state.ts:250`) and by tests.

- I make **no claim** on the "15342 pass / +8 storm / audit 0 / bundle 444.4/460" integration-gate numbers; those are outside source-readable evidence and were not re-executed.

Two MEDIUM items (both fail-safe: stale/`unknown`, never a false all-clear) + two disclosed low-risk redundant guards. No unbounded work, no XSS, no PII egress, no unhandled rejection reaching a safety-clearing path.
